contract.task_clause:
Which of the following describes the fallacy of false consolation?
Option A: arguing against a position based only on negative personal feelings toward the position
Option B: responding to charges of wrongdoing by saying others do things as bad or worse
Option C: arguing that someone is not really harmed because things could be worse or by pointing out what they have to be thankful for
Option D: using threats of harm instead of reasoning to get agreement
